responsibility: Declares the ranger cache data structures that store global SSA ranges, per-basic-block entry ranges, and inferred exit information used by the GIMPLE range engine. Its main public interface is ranger_cache, a range_query implementation that combines caches with GORI and inferred-range managers to answer expression, edge, and block range queries for gimple_ranger.
same_name_distinction: Declares the cache-side types and public interfaces, including block_range_cache, ssa_global_cache, and ranger_cache, that gcc/gimple-range-cache.cc implements. Unlike the .cc file, it defines the cache API surface and member layout rather than the dominator-search, cache-fill, and inferred-range update logic.
